notes.title: Halloween arrives in Tadeo Jones: The Emerald Tablet!
notes.notes:
Attention, explorers! The brave Tadeo and his friends return with exciting new content in Tadeo Jones - The Emerald Tablet, just in time for Halloween. The new free update is now available and will immerse you in a completely spooky atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/fa3ef9804cad45a6482d63e94991c4f462b75be8.png[/img]

What’s new in this update? 

● New terrifying environments: Get ready to explore a Chicago full of surprises, in both 2D and 3D, with guaranteed scares and a chilling atmosphere. 

● Pure Halloween visual elements: Ghosts, pumpkins, and bats decorate every corner of the game, adding a sinister and fun touch to your adventures. 

● Terrifying sounds: The new ambiance will keep you on edge, with Halloween sound effects perfectly integrated into the environments to create an even more immersive experience. 

● Spooky gameplay: Puzzles and challenges filled with the Halloween spirit to add an extra dose of excitement. 

● Dressed for the occasion: Tadeo, Sara, and Victoria couldn’t be left out and have decided to join the party with their best costumes for Día de los Muertos.

Your favorite explorer, Tadeo Jones, is back! Join Tadeo and his friends on an unforgettable journey through different cities, where thrilling action, endless laughter, and challenging puzzles await in your quest for the legendary emerald tablet. Now, with a terrifying twist you won’t want to miss!

notes.title: Tad: The Lost Explorer now available!
notes.notes:
The date has arrived, the date of the end of the world predicted by the Mayans? No! The date of the release of Tad: The Lost Explorer. After enjoying the film like pre-Columbians in a cenote full of hot chocolate, we couldn't wait to control the brilliant characters created by Enrique Gato with our own controller. In these communications we have been telling you advances and news about the launch of the game signed by GammeraNest and Mediaset Games. Today we can finally tell you that everything has been fulfilled: the physical and digital version for PS4 and PS5 is already in the shops, thanks to Selecta Play, and the Steam version can be found... well, on Steam, where it's going to be.

[previewyoutube=eUjvWHDPKBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember that in this videogame you will find an adventure faithful to the movie. You will have to guide the steps of Tad to free his beloved friends from the curse that affects them. The adventure stands out for its variety, the alternation of open 3D scenarios, which can be fully explored (Veracruz, Chicago, Paris, Egypt), and 2D platform levels, where the player's skill will be fundamental. 

Featured Content:

-Already available on PS4, PS5 (also in physical format) and Steam. 
-Tad-style storytelling. 
-Freedom to explore the 3D environments, full of collectibles and adventures. 
-Action in the 2D levels, to prove your skill at the controls. 
-Countless winks and surprises. 
Funny comic-book cinematics.

notes.title: Tad The Lost Explorer will be released on November 16
notes.notes:
Fans of Tad The Lost Explorer had a great time with Tad The Lost Explorer 3: The Emerald Tablet in theaters. 

However, the biggest fans among the biggest fans are still waiting for a second unique event: the release of the videogame adaptation of Tadeo 3, a project signed by GammeraNest and Mediaset Games. If you follow us often, you have already seen screenshots and trailers of the project, and we have already previewed many features. But here you have, at last, the definitive date on which you will be able to enjoy everything we have told you about: November 16, 2022. 

And, to celebrate it, we offer you a new trailer:

[previewyoutube=-iKq6DlUD5s;full][/previewyoutube]

On the 16th of next month, through PlayStation Store and Steam, you will experience all the gameplay, adventures, exploration, humor and surprises that the new video game of the saga holds (have you already added it to your whislist?). Oh, and very soon it will also be available on Nintendo Switch. 

Also remember that Tad The Lost Explorer, from Selecta Play, will have a physical version, which you can already book at your usual stores. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966690/Tadeo_Jones_La_Tabla_Esmeralda/

notes.title: Discover the physical editions of Tad the Lost explorer
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=uc30Dw5WW1M;full][/previewyoutube]

Tad the Lost Explorer is a 2.5D / 3D action-adventure where players will visit iconic and exotic locations (Paris, Veracruz, Chicago and El Cairo) in an epic journey to retrieve the emerald tablet while saving his friends. 

This time, Tad has found himself in a huge mess. During one of his expeditions, our beloved explorer has unleashed an ancient curse and now some of his friends have fallen under a wicked spell. To save them, and save the world, Tad will have to travel with his long-life friends, solve puzzles, overcome platforming sections and climb buildings to solve the ancient mystery that pursues him.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966690/Tad_the_Lost_Explorer_and_the_Emerald_Tablet/

[b]KEY FEATURES[/b]

[olist]
[*] Join Tad in his quest to retrieve the Emerald Tablet. Explore four different locations (Veracruz, Chicago, Paris, El Cairo) with your friends in an epic journey.
[*] Immerse in Tad's world. Traverse platforming sections, climb buildings and even swim among piranhas to solve an ancient mystery. 
[*] Find the lost relics and collect brushes. Solve puzzles to discover every hidden treasure in each of the four locations.
[*] Enjoy reading Tad's comic books. Follow the adventures of Tad, Sara, Jeff, and Belzoni in the comic books that you will find along the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Tad the Lost Explorer Announcement | Wishlist Now on STEAM
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966690/Tad_the_Lost_Explorer_and_the_Emerald_Tablet/

True to the film, funny, loaded with tons of  affectionate nods to the movie and humor. The game development studio Gammera Nest has just published a teaser which offers some first clues of what Tad the Lost Explorer will be about, the official videogame that adapts the third film of the adventures of the charismatic explorer, created by Enrique Gato. 

[previewyoutube=uc30Dw5WW1M;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, players can already include in their wishlists this title, which will initially be available on PlayStation and Steam, it promises hours of entertainment for both, IP  followers and their parents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/cbdbc6d57d90623788b45b14ff92c6c59f2adccc.jpg[/img]
 
In this installment, true to the plot of the film, Tad's quest to become a famous archaeologist, leads him to stick his nose into a place where no one should ever have gone. 

As a result, some of his best friends suffer the effect of a terrible curse that can only be reversed by finding the Emerald Tablet, an ancient relic created by a sorcerer to challenge the pharaoh`s power. 

With this premise, Gammera Nest studio, in collaboration with Mediaset Games and PS Talents, has developed a fun game that combines adventure, exploration, puzzles and platforms,  which are the best elements used in the film. 

This game stands out for its variety, alternating open 3D scenarios (Veracruz, Chicago, Paris, Egypt), which can be fully explored, as well 2D platform levels, where the player skills will be essential.  It should also be noted the game graphics quality (design and animations), which are very close to the film.

[b]Featured content:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Purest Tad Stones narrative style. 
[*] 3D scenarios which the player can freely explorate, these levels are full of adventures and collectibles. 
[*] 2D level action, try to demonstrate your skill playing as Tad with the controllers. 
[*] Countless nods to the movie and surprises. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/9129106f3141246996f4fa7493d96a92db467d83.jpg[/img]
